mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0% for at least 3 months) compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, with returns turning negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (base 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1300.0 thousand units, it indicates a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals a need for aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by non-farm payrolls above 145,000 thousand persons, supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 145000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
